description_zh: 调用DeleteMonitorGroup接口删除指定的应用分组
name: DeleteMonitorGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute a dry run on the request, including checks on permissions and instance status. Valid values:

false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check succeeds, the name and description of the routing table are directly modified.
true: Sends a check request to only perform the check, and the name and description of the routing table are not modified. The check items include whether required parameters are specified and the request format. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改路由表的名称和描述信息。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会路由表的名称和描述信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate a parameter value on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the deletion was successful

Group.description_en: The information about the deleted application group
Group.description_zh: 被删除的应用分组信息

GroupName.description_en: The name of the application group

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails. The example indicates that the required parameter GroupId is missing. No error message is returned when the deletion is successful
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误信息。示例表示缺少必填参数 GroupId。删除成功时没有错误信息
Message.example: GroupId is mandatory for this action.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the application group was deleted. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 删除应用分组是否成功。true表示成功，false表示失败
